เป็นที่ทราบกันดีว่า โรคเบาหวานชนิดที่ 2: It is well known that type 2 diabetes is a chronic non-communicable disease (NCDs) that causes great concern for patients and can lead to widespread complications in other organ systems. Most people with diabetes have to take medication regularly to keep their blood levels stable and inhibit the release of excess sugar from the liver, which may have a cumulative effect on liver and kidney function in the long term.
ในทางการแพทย์ ระดับน้ำตาลในเลือดสูงเป็นเ: Medically, high blood sugar is only one indicative symptom; the real cause is insulin resistance combined with the deterioration of pancreatic cells. In particular, when the body faces insulin resistance for a long time, the beta cells (Beta Cells) that produce insulin are overworked beyond their limit and gradually lose efficiency. Therefore, restoring pancreatic cells from within, along with keeping the blood vessels strong, is a key to helping control blood sugar levels sustainably.
5 สมุนไพรและสารสกัดกับบทบาทที่น่าสนใจต่อ: 5 Herbs and Extracts with Interesting Roles in Blood Sugar Levels
เห็ดหลินจือมีสารสำคัญในกลุ่มโพลีแซคคาไรด: Reishi mushroom contains key compounds in the polysaccharide group (Polysaccharides), which research has found have a notable ability to help stimulate insulin secretion from cells in the pancreas. It also helps reduce oxidative stress that damages pancreatic cells and helps lower blood cholesterol levels, effectively preventing vascular complications in people with diabetes.
กรดอะมิโนจำเป็นที่มีบทบาทสำคัญต่อระบบหลอ: An essential amino acid that plays an important role in the vascular system, L-Arginine is a precursor for producing nitric oxide (Nitric Oxide), which helps blood vessels dilate and stay flexible and naturally lowers blood pressure. As for diabetes, L-Arginine also helps increase insulin sensitivity, helping cells take up sugar from the bloodstream to use as energy more efficiently.
โกจิเบอร์รี่อุดมไปด้วยสาร LBP (Lycium Ba: Goji berry is rich in LBP (Lycium Barbarum Polysaccharides), which has biological activity that helps lower blood sugar levels by stimulating the uptake of glucose for use in various tissues. It is also a powerful antioxidant that helps protect blood vessels from being eroded and degraded by sugar.
ผู้ป่วยเบาหวานเรื้อรังมักเผชิญปัญหาเลือด: People with long-term diabetes often face poor blood circulation to the nerve endings due to degraded capillaries. Ginkgo biloba leaf extract helps stimulate peripheral blood circulation, reduce blood viscosity and keep blood vessels strong, preventing numbness in the hands and feet as well as preventing diabetic retinopathy.
โสมได้รับการขนานนามว่าเป็นราชาแห่งสมุนไพ: Ginseng is known as the king of herbs and contains key compounds called ginsenosides (Ginsenosides), which help lower blood sugar levels both before and after meals by supporting the pancreas in secreting insulin. It also helps lower bad cholesterol (LDL) in the blood vessels, which is a cause of high blood pressure.
